history.name: The tone every entry is written in
history.description: A ledger is written in one tone, chosen from four style guides: Google developer documentation, GOV.UK, Federal Plain Language, and ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. The command ledger style prints that tone as a sample paragraph of product prose and three feature descriptions written in it, which is the thing a writer or an agent matches. Running ledger style set moves the project to another guide, or to a tone you write as prose yourself in .ledger/STYLE.md.
history.dev_notes: src/style.mjs holds all four samples; they describe the same fictional product (examples/northwind) so the only difference between them is register. resolveStyle() throws for an unknown id or a missing STYLE.md.
